comparison.objective: Join the two lower links of a five-bar robot leg using a stud-and-jaw connection; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Align articulated links and press a stud into a latching jaw.
comparison.success_condition: The orange stud clicks into the blue jaw and the robot releases the assembly; quantitative latch thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests alignment and snap-latching to create a joint, whereas the candidate breaks sacrificial tangs while preserving installed coils and then recovers fragments.
